hŏmōnymus , a, um, adj., = ὁμώνυμος,
I.of the same name, homonymous: “sicut in his, quae homonyma vocantur: ut, Taurus animal sit, an mons, an signum in caelo, an nomen hominis, an radix arboris, nisi distinctum non intelligitur,” Quint. 8, 2, 13 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
